checkpoint.durable_events: Submission intent is persisted before POST. A predeclared per-attempt durable header-receipt sidecar in the batch work directory is written atomically by the HTTP worker immediately after response headers arrive, before body streaming, and survives controller/worker interruption. The sidecar cryptographically binds sanitized status/selected headers plus receipt wall-clock and monotonic times. If controller interruption occurs during bounded submission-body streaming, the spawned worker is stopped and already-fsynced bounded body bytes are atomically copied from temporary IPC to the batch work directory before cleanup, then hash-bound into the retained uncertain submission envelope. Final submission evidence, canonical receipt envelope, job URL/deadline, every phase observation, abort state, result validation, retry count and interruption state are separately persisted.

failure_semantics.cross_query: Sum selected science-key source_rows per plate <= that plate Q2 all-processing source_rows; otherwise HOLD.
failure_semantics.csv: UTF-8-sig, strict CSV parser over preserved newlines; exact header/order/width; reject CR/LF/NUL in integer fields; integers never parsed through float.
failure_semantics.failed_result_evidence: Hash and retain raw/partial aggregate response bytes before validation, with per-attempt provenance; never echo body values in logs. Invalid checkpoints are preserved and cannot silently trigger new queries.
failure_semantics.q2_relationships: nonnegative counts; scans <= scan/process/solution combinations <= source_rows; processes <= process/solution combinations <= scan/process/solution combinations; positive source_rows require both composite counts >= 1.
failure_semantics.tap_submission_explicit_rejection: HTTP 4xx except 408: TAP_SUBMISSION_REJECTED_HOLD; status/selected headers/body hash and bounded raw response are preserved; no automatic resubmission.
failure_semantics.tap_submission_uncertain: Transport failure, HTTP 408, unexpected non-accepted 2xx/3xx/5xx, or accepted status without a valid same-origin job Location: SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN_HOLD; evidence preserved; no automatic resubmission.
failure_semantics.zero_source_rows: ZERO_SOURCE_ROWS_CONFIRMED only when expected Q1 selected-key row exists and source_rows=0

network_accounting: Counters are initiated HTTP operation attempts, including failures. Report this invocation separately from cumulative retained batch evidence. Git verification remains separate. Individual source and pixel calls remain zero.

publication.controller_lock: OS byte-range/file lock at ProjectRoot/work/v095a_stageA_controller.lock, held through all mutable preflight, batch and publication work; released by OS on process death.
publication.final_publish: Unique staging directory, validated checkpoint allowlist, recursive SHA-256 manifest including job evidence, atomic rename under project lock; never delete another staging directory.
publication.resume: Resume only the exact release/context/query/expected-key identity. Reuse validated results; reconcile retained active jobs under the original cryptographically bound header-receipt deadline; never reset attempt budgets or automatically replace invalid/failed checkpoints.

q2_empty_plate_correction.implementation: CASE WHEN COUNT(sc.plate_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT composite_tuple) END

repair_provenance.rc6_blocker_found_by_manual_review: RC6 wrote immediate receipt headers only to temporary transport IPC before controller finalization; a controller crash after return could still lose received status/Location. RC6 also documented but did not mechanically enforce disposition of the preserved RC4 unknown submission before a future live POST.
repair_provenance.rc7_remaining_blockers_found_by_manual_c: The terminal deadline still began after POST body collection, and a final submission receipt could validate with a missing disposition. RC9 changes only those mechanical receipt/lifecycle controls and their regressions.
repair_provenance.rc7_staged_candidate_status: Immutable but never submitted for independent review; coordinator recovery audit found remaining RC6 R1b/R2 requirements before a GPT REQUEST was posted.
repair_provenance.tap_compatibility_rewrite: APPLAUSE live PostgreSQL parser rejects top-level WITH and aggregate FILTER. Q0/Q1/Q2 input VALUES CTEs are represented as deterministic derived SELECT/UNION ALL integer relations; Q1 FILTER row counts are represented as SUM(CASE WHEN predicate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END); Q2 empty-left-join composite counts are guarded with CASE WHEN COUNT(sc.plate_id)=0 THEN 0. Live probes established equivalent required behaviour.
repair_provenance.trigger: RC4 first live Q0 submission returned an unaccepted HTTP status, but RC4 did not persist the status/headers/body before entering SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN_HOLD.

scientific_role: Aggregate-only, candidate-identity-blind inventory of APPLAUSE DR4 for the exact retained v094z geometry population. No individual source extraction, cross-observatory source pairing, pixels, scans, or candidate inspection.

selected_solution_binding.parent: completed frozen v094t source-free opportunity census intersected by exact v094z pair_id

stop_rule: STOP after validated aggregate inventory and interpretation. No individual source row extraction or matching.

tap.abort_policy: 135 s total budget for abort POST and terminal-phase confirmation. An HTTP acknowledgement alone is not a confirmed abort. Unconfirmed jobs remain recorded and block new submissions.
tap.authentication: APPLAUSE_TOKEN environment variable if present; otherwise anonymous; token value must never be logged
tap.get_redirects: At most three redirects, HTTPS same archive origin, within the original operation deadline.
tap.http_wall_enforcement: Each HTTP operation runs in a spawned child. Parent terminates it at the smaller of 135 s and the remaining operation/job budget. Process cleanup: terminate/join 2 s, kill/join 2 s; HOLD if not stopped.
tap.per_attempt_terminal_deadline_origin: Exactly 3900 seconds from the cryptographically bound header/job-Location receipt time, never from completion of POST response-body collection.
tap.post_redirects: Submission POST is not automatically followed: record and validate Location before polling. Unknown acceptance is a durable HOLD, never an automatic resubmission.

retry.scope: Three submission attempts total per batch across every invocation; 30/120 s delays. Validation failures and unknown submission receipts are sticky HOLDs.

submission_response_evidence.mandatory_disposition_by_state: Any final submission envelope requires a known disposition. WAITING/FETCHING/VALIDATED/ABORT_PENDING/RETRYABLE require JOB_RECEIPT_VALIDATED; a validated-job disposition left in SUBMITTING is a conservative HOLD.
submission_response_evidence.receipt_timing_binding: Header receipt wall/monotonic times are self-hash-bound, repeated in the final envelope, and must exactly define submitted/deadline fields for progressed job states.
submission_response_evidence.worker_durable_header_sidecar: Predeclared attempt_XX_submission_headers.json under the batch work directory; atomic fsync+replace immediately after status/selected headers arrive and before body streaming.

tap.terminal_deadline_scope: 3900 s from receipt of the job URL; original UTC/monotonic expiry retained on resume; late terminal responses rejected.
tap.timeout_action: record TAP_TIMEOUT_HOLD then attempt UWS abort
